card.title: IPad Pro 12.9 No touch after screen replacement repair

source.title: IPad Pro 12.9 No touch after screen replacement repair

claims.statement: iPad Pro 12.9 (1st/2nd gen) losing touch after a screen job usually has a blown touch filter at the far end of one display connector from plugging in with the battery connected.

procedure: Find and replace the blown touch filter.
card.caveats: Community-written Repair Wiki page, paraphrased; check the linked page (and its images) before acting on a reading.
